Subject: Post-call recap + budget confirmation (Acme Payments)

Hi Jordan / Lexi —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a formal quote: 

Call recap:
- Use case: fraud-detection enrichment + realtime scoring in checkout (low-latency) + daily batch embeddings for analytics.
- Model pattern: mostly short prompts (50-150 tokens) for realtime scoring; batch embedding jobs ~1k tokens on average.
- Expected peaks: synchronous checkout traffic (~tens of reqs/s) + nightly batch runs.

Asks / open items for pricing:
1) Monthly token volume band (estimate ranges are fine): low / expected / high for both realtime and batch.
2) Any procurement thresholds we should know about (PO process, approval level for $X/mo, required vendor paperwork).
3) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens or target monthly spend range (helps us map to Dedicated vs Hosted)?

Attached a simple pricing workbook (redwood-pricing-1Mtokens.xlsx) that shows example math across model variants and batching assumptions.

If you can send the three items above, I’ll run the numbers with Ethan and get a 60/90-day pilot recommendation + an estimated monthly cost band.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Marissa — good recap. Quick answers below: 

Monthly token volumes (ballpark):
- Realtime scoring: low 5M / expected 15M / high 30M tokens/month
- Batch embeddings: low 2M / expected 8M / high 12M tokens/month

Procurement thresholds / process:
- Purchases <= $10k/month: handled by Engineering PO (fast)
- $10k-$50k/month: needs Procurement approval (2-3 weeks)
- > $50k/month: requires legal + finance sign-off and SOC2 attachments (4-6 weeks)

Target unit economics: We’re aiming for ~ $120/1M tokens (total cost) as a negotiation benchmark. If you can show a path where production costs are ~ $100-130/1M with predictable SLAs, that will work.

Happy to hop on a quick follow-up with Ethan to validate assumptions — Lexi, can you confirm if the embedding jobs are batched overnight and whether there’s a sliding window retention for embeddings?

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>

Hey Jordan / Lexi —

Thanks for the numbers, that’s very helpful. A few quick clarifications + a sample unit-econ calculation so you have a sense of how the pricing workbook maps to your volumes: 

Notes:
- Tokenization: "tokens per input" will vary by prompt and language. For short realtime prompts we commonly see ~60-120 tokens per request.
- Batching/quantization: Dedicated deployments and optimized batching can materially reduce $/1M tokens vs pure hosted (we typically show 15-40% savings depending on model variant).

Example cost calc (illustrative):
- Realtime expected 15M tokens/month. If Hosted model rate = $150/1M tokens (base public rate in sheet), gross cost = 15 * $150 = $2,250/month.
- With Dedicated and batching/kv-cache improvements we can often reach equivalent unit costs ~ $100-$120/1M -> 15 * $115 = $1,725/month.
- Batch embeddings (8M tokens) are cheaper per token due to throughput optimizations; estimate $60-80/1M -> 8 * $70 = $560/month.
- Combined estimated monthly spend (expected band) = hosted combined = (15*$150)+(8*$70)=2250+560=2810; dedicated optimized = (15*$115)+(8*$70)=1725+560=2285 => ~$2.3k/month.

I'll attach a quick usage heatmap (map-of-usage.png) and update the redwood-pricing workbook with a Dedicated vs Hosted comparison for the bands you gave.

Next steps I propose:
- Ethan to share an updated workbook + 60-day pilot recommendation (by EOD tomorrow).
- Marissa to include procurement guidance in the formal quote.
- Jordan / Lexi confirm any special compliance docs needed for >$50k threshold.

Ethan Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwoodinference.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Looping in to help move procurement forward. Jordan — great to see the target of $120/1M; that gives us a clear band to work toward. From a Redwood commercial perspective here’s what we can do quickly: 

- Pilot: 60-day pilot targeting your expected volumes (15M realtime / 8M batch) with a capped pilot spend of $7,000. Pilot includes 24/7 support for onboarding and a one-week SLA guarantee for checkout latency.
- Procurement: I’ll prepare a short-form quote. For purchases <= $10k/mo we can accept your standard PO. If it looks like you’ll exceed $10k/mo after pilot, we’ll coordinate legal and SOC2 paperwork early to avoid delays.
- Pricing: Ethan, please include both Hosted and Dedicated band comparisons in the workbook (+ recommended model variant). Marissa, can you send Jordan the updated workbook + a formal quote link + DocuSign for the pilot so Procurement can start review?

Marissa — please confirm you’ll send the quote today and we’ll target signature/PO next week if procurement is on the fast track.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
